settings.mask: Exact uses all RGB including invisible texels; fuzzy uses Java alpha>0.05 on 16x16 nearest visibility, ignores source alpha
settings.sparse: visible fraction<0.10 requires name support>=0.4; very low variance requires flat+name gate
settings.tie_break: exact class; for fuzzy acceptable logical name, then spatial score/category/source ID/frame
settings.rgb24_mers: Importer compatibility approximation: RGB MERS is interpreted as MER with missing S=0
settings.mers_winner: Bedrock M>S keeps M and clears S; otherwise keeps S and clears M (tie selects S); E/R unchanged
settings.projection: Exact whole sheet first; otherwise nearest source RGB frame per Java frame, static source repeated; host alpha/tint preserved
settings.normal: DirectX source XYZ normalized; green sign retained because Prime bitangent follows +V/image-down; biased XY, mip0 distribution0, IOR85
settings.frame_tie: Numbered Java icons prefer equal source index among identical RGB; other animation frames prefer equal sheet index; first used frame fixes selected candidate
